title: calypsodium boreale

It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of the calypsodium plant are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
